verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal offers online filing and IP-management services, so asking whether those services are also available through an API is a fair question. The evidence only describes UI and online procedures such as patent, trademark and design filings, renewals and title requests, plus an online filing guide. Nothing documents a public API, let alone one that matches the UI, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
